{{Quote|I don't need a lecture about murder from a skulker.|Zeerid Korr|<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>}}
'''Skulkers''' was a derogatory nickname for [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]], used by soldiers around the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], such as [[Zeerid Korr]], a former commando pilot with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The term may have been particularly applied to members of the elite [[Imperial sniper corps]] in the opposing [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Sith army]].<ref name="Deceived" />

The sniper [[Vrath Xizor]] regarded the name as an insult.<ref name="Deceived" />
